subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall accept a product-side ruling from the human operator, and from Argus only where Argus's authority contract grants that act.
rationale: New intent stays the product side's call; Argus acts only under grant (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-4, brainstorm:feature-draft#D-9)
fit_criterion: Operator rulings are accepted; an Argus ruling is accepted under a granting authority contract and refused without one; any other agent's ruling is refused.
